india.one_line: India's cyber agency warns banks and fintechs of AI-driven fraud attacks on payment systems.

themes.title: Cyber agency warns of AI fraud
themes.text: The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) issued an advisory warning banks, NBFCs and fintech firms that attackers are using AI agents to exploit unpatched software and payment APIs for multi-crore fraudulent transactions. It urges institutions to implement CERT-In advisories, set transaction limits and report incidents within six hours.
